description: Read two to five public clinical trials by NCT ID in one call, with the fields that matter side by side: status, phase, conditions, interventions, sponsor, ages, sex, healthy volunteers, enrollment, dates and site count. Use it after search_clinical_trials when a person is choosing between trials. An ID the registry does not know comes back in notFound. Registry contacts are left out. Not medical advice; do not rank trials for a person.
name: compare_clinical_trials

distanceMiles.description: Miles to the nearest site, only when a zip or radius was searched.

lastUpdatePostDate.description: Date the registry last updated the record (YYYY-MM-DD).

locations.description: At most the first 10 sites. Use the trial page for all of them.

maxAge.description: Maximum age in whole years, null when the registry gives none.

minAge.description: Minimum age in whole years, null when the registry gives none.

phase.description: Registry phases joined with a slash, for example PHASE2/PHASE3.

title: Compare clinical trials
